func:
const d = msg.payload || {};

msg.params = {
    $node_id: d.node_id,
    $timestamp: d.timestamp,

    $co: d.co ?? null,
    $ch4: d.ch4 ?? null,
    $temp: d.temp ?? null,
    $hum: d.hum ?? null,

    // Kolom lama tetap dipertahankan.
    $wind_speed: d.wind_speed_sensor ??
        d.wind_speed ?? null,

    // Pemisahan dua sumber angin.
    $wind_speed_sensor: d.wind_speed_sensor ??
        d.wind_speed ?? null,

    $wind_speed_weather:
        d.wind_speed_weather ?? null,

    // Open-Meteo.
    $wind_direction_deg:
        d.wind_direction_deg ?? null,

    $wind_direction:
        d.wind_direction ?? null,

    // FRI aktual.
    $fri: d.fri ?? null,
    $fri_level: d.fri_level ?? null,

    // Baseline spread.
    $spread_rate_base_cmph:
        d.spread_rate_base_cmph ?? null,

    $wind_effect_factor:
        d.wind_effect_factor ?? null,

    $spread_rate_cmph:
        d.spread_rate_cmph ?? null,

    $spread_model:
        d.spread_model ?? null
};

return msg;

INSERT INTO sensor_readings
(
    node_id,
    timestamp,
    co,
    ch4,
    temp,
    hum,
    wind_speed,
    wind_speed_sensor,
    wind_speed_weather,
    wind_direction_deg,
    wind_direction,
    fri,
    fri_level,
    spread_rate_base_cmph,
    wind_effect_factor,
    spread_rate_cmph,
    spread_model
)
VALUES
(
    $node_id,
    $timestamp,
    $co,
    $ch4,
    $temp,
    $hum,
    $wind_speed,
    $wind_speed_sensor,
    $wind_speed_weather,
    $wind_direction_deg,
    $wind_direction,
    $fri,
    $fri_level,
    $spread_rate_base_cmph,
    $wind_effect_factor,
    $spread_rate_cmph,
    $spread_model
);
